integrity: The complete graph model, Morse matching, integer chains, automorphism matrices and checks are reproduced by the embedded standalone Python program. No external independent audit or certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: One finite graph; rational equivariant homology only; no integral quotient classification or general torsion theorem. Known nonequivariant results are background and not claimed as new. Unindexed equivalent work remains possible.
title: Full dihedral and color-symmetry homology of the seven-cycle categorical product
